comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Faster requests and pages
themes.text: A server answers a keep-alive request with fewer system calls. An HTML page writes whole numbers and escaped text faster. A call on a `Core` object finds its method without looking up a name.
